notes.title: Demo v1.1.0
notes.content:
We've made a few improvements to the demo based on your feedback:

[list]
[*] The time is now always visible — no need to open the traffic tab to check it.
[*] Floating products are gone for good!
[*] Game economy update: you can now place as many machines as you want — no more limits!
[/list]

Thanks for playing and sharing your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Twitch Integration Coming to Tiny Vending Machines!
notes.content:
Exciting News: Twitch Integration Coming to Tiny Vending Machines!
Hey vending enthusiasts!
We're thrilled to announce that Tiny Vending Machines is getting Twitch integration! This new feature will transform how you play and stream our game.
🔴 LIVESTREAM POWER-UP: Your viewers can now directly impact your gameplay by helping increase foot traffic to your vending machines.
HOW IT WORKS:

Stream Tiny Vending Machines on your Twitch channel
Viewers type "!join" in chat
Watch as new customers appear at your vending locations in real-time!

This creates an interactive experience where your community directly contributes to your in-game success. More customers mean more sales and faster progression!

notes.title: 🎉 Tiny Vending Machines Open Beta is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that the Open Beta for Tiny Vending Machines has officially started! 🚀

To join the beta and start playing, just head to the game’s Steam page and click the “Request Access” button. It’s quick and free!

📝 Got feedback?
You can submit your thoughts through the feedback form available directly from the in-game menu. We’re listening closely and your input is incredibly valuable as we continue to improve the game.

Thanks for being part of this journey—we can’t wait to hear what you think!

— The Tiny Vending Machines Team

notes.title: New monitor/window settings and our fresh per-machine pricing system
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549213/d5d0f03e6561f65dc4278ade9f10f81d88e3c8ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549213/8d4c22a52e1f753855f8476a1dc88d0057d49235.png[/img][/url]

Hey everyone,
Here’s a quick dev diary to wrap up the day. We’ve made a few quality-of-life improvements and added a brand new feature!

🖥️ Monitor, Window & Background Options
You can now:

Choose which monitor the game runs on

Move the game window up or down

Toggle the background on or off—ideal for customizing your experience and keeping your desktop clear

💰 Per-Machine Pricing
You can now set individual product prices per machine! This gives you more strategic control over your production and income. Keep in mind that pricing will impact your sales, so plan accordingly.
We’ll share a more detailed post soon to explain how this system works in depth.

Thanks for checking in—and as always, we appreciate your support!

Join the community
Want to chat, leave feedback, or get sneak peeks at upcoming features? Join us on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/yw7s3JyRfq]Discord[/url]
